task_definitions.diabetes_report: DIQ010 1 versus 2, borderline/refused/unknown excluded. Self-reported diagnosed diabetes, not type-2-specific or future onset.
task_definitions.kidney_report: KIQ022 1 versus 2: ever told weak/failing kidneys, excluding kidney stones/infection. NOT CKD confirmed over >=3 months.
task_definitions.cvd_report: Any MCQ160C/E/F=1 (ever CHD/MI/stroke), negative only if all three=2. Self-reported prevalent cardiovascular history.
task_definitions.liver_report: MCQ160L 1 versus 2: ever told any liver condition; not histological fibrosis or current adjudicated disease.
